title: AV
paragraphs: Father showed me a round shield that seemed to be designed with the image of the moon.
“Moonstone Shield?”
“It has been passed down by that name. It was crafted as a shield and grants various blessings and protections.”
“In fantasy settings, the moon often has strong magical significance. It makes sense for there to be an item like this,” Itsuki said while observing the shield Father was holding.
It has a bit of a witch-like vibe to it.
“Do we get one too?”
“We can arrange for one, but it would need to be ordered.”
“So, Naofumi just happened to find one in stock. Well, Naofumi, did you find any useful skills?”
“Uh… Crescent Shield… it says,” Father recited the skill name, and a glowing, crescent-shaped barrier appeared in front of him when viewed from the side.
However, it only covered a portion of the front.
“Huh? Besides the skill cooldown, there’s also a time counter showing up…”
After a while, the glowing barrier started to expand slightly.
“Half-Moon Shield?”
When Father activated the skill again, the barrier transformed into a large half-moon shape.
“Could this be a skill where the defensive area increases over time?”
“That sounds pretty inconvenient.”
“As a defensive skill, it’s a compromise… It’s clearly designed to mimic the phases of the moon.”
“Meteor Shield creates a full defensive barrier instantly.”
“Looks like we’ll have to find a way to secure a Meteorite Iron Shield.”
“Let’s hope this isn’t just a weaker skill. We haven’t fully unlocked it yet, so maybe investing points into it will make a big difference.”
With that, Father began adjusting the shield.
“Alright, Itsuki, are you going to practice sniping?”
“Yeah.”
At the shooting range adjacent to the weapon shop, Itsuki pulled the trigger of his bow, which had transformed into a handgun. With a sharp “pash!” sound, the bullet hit the center of the target.
“The feeling isn’t bad. Not having to draw the string is pretty convenient.”
He was hitting the target while looking away. Quite the skillful display.
“As expected of the Accuracy Hero.”
“Seriously, Itsuki is pretty much a finished fighter. Can you still use your previous skills?”
“It seems like I can. Arrow Rain!”
With a loud pash!, Itsuki fired a shot into the air, which then burst and rained down bullets. Rather than Arrow Rain, it felt more like a bullet storm.
“The damage changes depending on level and stats, huh? Even firearms that are tricky to use seem like versatile weapons in the hands of the Bow Hero.”
“The rapid-fire capability puts him way ahead of us, who rely on close combat.”
“It looks even more useful than magic.”
“Please don’t exclude me from the conversation,” Itsuki said. “Compared to the natural-disaster-class magic you unleashed last time, Motoyasu, this is nothing.”
As we talked, we finished preparing our equipment. When we returned to our room, the castle soldiers were waiting for us.
“Heroes of the Four Holy Weapons, King Faubrey has summoned you. Would you be willing to grant him an audience?”
“We understand. We’ll be there right away.”
With that, we headed straight to answer the summons of the Pig King, making our way to the audience chamber. Just like last time, a deafening fanfare echoed through the hall.
“Bufufufufu… Well, well, Shield Hero, Spear Hero. And also, Sword Hero and Bow Hero. Did you rest well last night?”
“Well… it seems like you had quite a lot of fun.”

“Bufufufufu… I am quite satisfied with the gifts from the Shield Hero and Spear Hero. I am thoroughly enjoying myself. Women truly are wonderful… And watching him suffer while I indulge makes it even better.”
At this, Itsuki whispered something into Father’s ear. I can understand the sentiment, to some extent.
“Why does he only address Naofumi and Motoyasu with ‘san’? Also, he’s openly making some completely outrageous statements.”
“Ahaha…”
“Bufufu, I’ve heard that the Spear Hero is reliving the same time over and over. Do you have any other amusing stories to share?”
“I can’t think of any more topics that would entertain King Faubrey.”
More importantly, let’s just move this conversation along. By yesterday, the plans for today should have already been decided.
“Bufufufu, I was simply hoping to hear a bit more about the future. What may seem trivial to the Spear Hero might be of great value to me.”
It seems the Pig King is interested in hearing about the future. When someone asks so blatantly, it’s only natural to feel tempted to share something.
“Well… if I recall correctly, when we captured the Crimson Swine, Father told us to record proof of King Faubrey carrying out an execution.”
“W-What… did you say!?”
The Pig King forgot to let out his usual bufufu laugh and instead gripped the armrest of his throne tightly. Even though he’s a pig, his face is painted with sheer ‘shock’.
“M-Motoyasu-kun? I feel like you just stepped on something you shouldn’t have…”
“Wait, what do you mean by ‘execution’?”

Was that really such a big deal? At the time, Father was extremely wary of the Crimson Swine, so he took that precaution just in case. In the end, Takt had outmaneuvered us, and the Crimson Swine managed to escape. But… what’s with this reaction from the Pig King?
“That is truly wonderful. To preserve my relationship with women… I have considered it, but to actually show it to others—just as expected of the Shield Hero.”
“That wasn’t me! That was a version of me from another timeline!” Father desperately denied it.
“But this is fascinating! Many people will get to witness my actions… absolutely marvelous!”
The Pig King was grinning from ear to ear.
Does he really find it so enjoyable to show others his own debauchery?
“I’d rather not watch that kind of AV if possible.”
“Yeah.”
“Agreed.”
Father and the others responded instinctively. Who in their right mind would want to watch an animal video starring pigs?
“Oh? Did you say something, Shield Hero?”

By the way, Father and the others assume it’s just a regular adult video, but in the original world, Father referred to it as ‘hard gore.’ Should I mention that? Well, I can just bring it up later as a minor topic.
“No, nothing. More importantly, is that why you called us here?”
“Bufufufu, it would be worthwhile enough for that alone, but unfortunately, no. This time, it’s an optional request—you may refuse if you wish.”
At the Pig King’s clap, the Queen, Fiancé, and Éclair entered through another doorway.
“Heroes of the Four Holy Weapons, I understand you may be angered by the actions of my country, Melromarc, but please, hear me out.”
“Could we first hear what this is about?”
This is just a performance. We already discussed this yesterday.
“The client is the Queen of Melromarc, the country that summoned you heroes. Due to certain circumstances, she is currently in exile here in Faubrey. Are you aware of this?”
“Yes. Melromarc is effectively under the control of the Three Heroes Church, right?”
“Bufufu, then this will be quick. You heroes owe them nothing. I’d advise against accepting, but what will you do?”
“Hmm…”

Father pretended to consider the request. Although we had already spoken with the Queen beforehand, answering too quickly might seem suspicious. For a while, Ren, Itsuki, and I followed Father’s lead and acted as if we were thinking it over. Then, after a short pause, Father spoke.
“Very well, we’ll accept.”
“Indeed. The actions of the Three Heroes Church have become intolerable.”
“And it’s not like we want to be enemies with Melromarc either.”
We all nodded along. We had decided from the beginning that we would accept.
“Then, you may receive the details from the Queen of Melromarc herself. I just remembered I have other matters to attend to, so this audience is now over.”

The Pig King seemed eager to wrap things up quickly. Ending the audience in haste, he made his exit. The soldiers and ministers looked a little exasperated, but at the same time, they also seemed somewhat relieved. Is it difficult to get work done with the Pig King around?
“He went to make it.”
“So it really is an AV?”
“…Please don’t tell me we’ll be forced to watch it later, Naofumi-san.”
“Why me? Shouldn’t it be Motoyasu?”
With that conversation behind us, we turned to face the Queen.
“Now, let’s discuss the details—”
